At work, we got our app compiling without warnings on#ElixirLang 1.20-rc.6. The new type system discovered ~500 issues that 1.19 did not. - Most were just dead code (handling patterns that could never actually match in practice) - A handful were outright bugs. (See below)

2:35 PM · May 28, 2026

27

‪Tyler A. Young ⚗️🧑🏻‍💻‬‪@tylerayoung.com‬

My favorite of the bugs it caught (we had a few of these!): {:error, reason} -> {:error, "Failed to do the thing:#{reason}"} ...where the compiler could prove that `reason` didn't implement the String.Chars protocol, and therefore the error handler would crash 100% of the time.
